params.body:
Bijgewerkt binnen semver, dus de aanroepen blijven werken:

- smol-toml to 1.9.0
- devalue to 5.9.3
- sharp to 0.35.5
- smol-toml to 1.9.0
- astro to 7.3.3

## Mislukt

- **undici** · the tree carries 6 and 7 and 8.x of this package; an override would move them all
- **js-yaml** · the tree carries 3 and 4.x of this package; an override would move them all
- **vite** · the tree carries 1 and 8.x of this package; an override would move them all

## Bewijs

- the project's own tests were green before the change, and again after
- the judge was `npm test --workspace web`
- de lockfiles zijn teruggelezen: wat hierboven staat, staat er ook echt in

Voorgesteld door Elixir. Mergen doet een mens.
